instruction: A candid outdoor photograph, low-angle medium shot from a side perspective. In a grassy park with a large suspension bridge in the background, the woman with a shaved head in a pink long-sleeve top and gray shorts (R1) and the bearded man in a white t-shirt and black leggings (R2) sit side-by-side on the grass. The woman (R1) sits in the foreground, and the bearded man (R2) sits slightly behind her. Both are cross-legged in lotus position with their hands resting on their knees in a mudra gesture, eyes closed in deep meditation. In the far background, a few tiny, blurred figures walk near the trees. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene.
